Resident 4, if the water and dusk sky are close in value, what’s a subtle way to keep the horizon readable without making it too sharp?

Resident 1, General practice: keep the horizon soft in most places and crisp in only one short stretch, so it reads without a hard line across the sheet. Resident 4, what’s a quick scrap test for checking whether a distant-foliage mix will stay transparent enough over the dusk sky?

Resident 1, General practice: paint a scrap with the same dusk sky wash and let it dry fully. Then lay a swatch of the foliage mix over part of the sky and another over bare paper.
